notes.title: Blurry Textures Hotfix | v1.0.2
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that the latest update addresses an issue that was causing blurry textures for some players. This was due to certain streaming textures parameters in Unreal Engine 5, which were impacting users with lower VRAM.

With this fix, players with limited VRAM should now see sharper and clearer textures, improving the overall visual experience. Thank you to everyone who reported this issue—we appreciate your feedback and patience while we worked on it!

Happy Collecting!

notes.title: Day One Update | v1.0.1
notes.content:
Here is the v.1.0.1 update for Crack It Up! with a number of improvements and fixes:

[list]
[*] [b]Luck Boosting Power-Up Description Update:[/b] We've improved the description of the "Luck Boosting" power-up! Now it’s clearer that this power-up increases the chances of seeing cards with a green arrow in the Sell Cards menu. This means more high-value cards to sell!

[*] [b]Russian Translation Fixes:[/b] We've fixed some translation issues in the Russian language, thanks to Relvi. Huge thanks to them for helping improve the experience for our Russian-speaking players!

[*] [b]Options Menu Adjustment:[/b] The options menu now adjusts its size properly based on the selected language, ensuring a better fit for all languages.

[*] [b]Button Text Overflow Fixes:[/b] We’ve fixed issues where text was overflowing the buttons in certain languages, improving readability.

[*] [b]Save "Don’t Sell Last Card" Setting:[/b] Now, if you choose not to sell your last card by ticking the box, the setting will be saved and stay active even after you close the game. No need to set it again!
[/list]

A big thank you to all players who’ve purchased Crack It Up! so far! Your feedback has been incredibly helpful. We really appreciate your support!

Happy collecting!

notes.title: 🎉 Crack It Up! is Now Live! 🎉
notes.content:
The wait is over – Crack It Up! is officially available on Steam! Dive into a world of card packs, adorable animal collectibles, and thrilling trades. Open packs, boost your luck, and complete your collection!

If you encounter any issues, please don’t hesitate to report them – we’ll work to resolve them as quickly as possible.

Thank you to everyone who supported us during development. Now, it’s time to start cracking packs and create your ultimate collection!

Get started now and happy collecting!

notes.title: Release Date Revealed & Full Game Content Overview
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
We’re thrilled to announce that Crack It Up will officially launch on [b]November 11th[/b]  — just one week away!  🎉

[b]🎮 What’s in the Full Game?
[/b]
The full version of Crack It Up brings all the content and polish you’ve been waiting for, making it the best experience we could make for collection fans. Here’s what you can expect:
[list]
[*] [u]5 Collections Included:[/u] The complete game will feature five unique collections, each one increasing in cost as you progress, like an incremental game — but don’t worry, higher-level cards also sell for more!
[*] [u]Upgrade Menu:[/u] With the upgrade menu now available, you can unlock enhancements that make opening packs more efficient and rewarding.
[*] [u]Enhanced Visual & Sound Feedback:[/u] We’ve polished all systems to improve the overall experience and made the game world even more interactive and immersive, we've also added some easter eggs!
[/list]
[b]💲 Launch Price & Launch Discount
[/b]
The game will cost the equivalent of two Wild Life packs, [b]$5.99 USD[/b]! 

There’s more good news — we will be offering a launch discount, so don’t miss the chance to get it at a reduced price!

Thank you all for your support and feedback throughout the development. We can’t wait for you to dive into Crack It Up on November 11th! Get ready to complete your collections, unlock upgrades, and enjoy the thrill of every pack. See you in-game!

notes.title: Thanks for playing the Demo!
notes.content:
We want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo of Crack It Up! during Steam Next Fest. Your feedback has been invaluable and will help us shape the final version of the game. We appreciate your support and your insights!

The demo will remain active for those of you still playing and continuing your journey. However, it will be taken down when the full game launches. But don’t worry—the prologue will stay live permanently for anyone who wants to play it.

We’re excited to share that Crack It Up! is reaching the final stages of development and will be launching soon. Stay tuned as we’ll be revealing the release date shortly!

Thank you again for all your support, and we can’t wait for you to experience the full game!

notes.title: Steam Fest Demo & Prologue Update!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to showcase Crack It Up! to a wider audience during Steam Next Fest with our new demo.

If you've already downloaded the Prologue, there's no need to download the demo separately! We'll be updating the Prologue to match the latest demo version, so just make sure to dowload the last update of the Prologue and you'll get the same experience.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to hear what you think!

notes.content:
